title: Notification
description: Definition of Notification under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: a notification published in the Official Gazette and the term "notify" shall be construed accordingly
content.plain_language: an official announcement published in the government's gazette
examples: A government ministry publishes a new rule in the Official Gazette
A public notice is issued in the gazette about a change in consumer protection laws
non_examples: A company posts an update on its website
A social media post by a government official

user_queries: What is a notification in the Consumer Protection Act
What is meant by notification in law
